title: Let's Cultivate Food

services.name: Cooking Classes
services.desc: LCF offers a fun, approachable way to explore global flavors. Enjoy our signature seasonal beverages with every class while learning hands-on in the comfort of your home or our 360° panoramic-view Greenhouse. We organically grow our herbs and many ingredients from seed whenever possible, and every class is guided live by the chef from start to finish-never from a recipe sheet-making the experience engaging and accessible for all skill levels. Fill out our Inquiry form. Choose Greenhouse or In-Home, and you’ll receive a follow-up email with everything you’ll need to get started. Receive your menus.
